name: responsive-dialog
title: Responsive Dialog
description: One overlay API that is a centred Dialog from 768px up and a bottom Sheet with a drag handle and a safe-area footer below it — the same header, body and footer in both.

meta.whenToUse: A dialog that must also work on a phone: share, members, move, create flows.
meta.whenNotToUse: A desktop-only modal (Dialog) or a side panel (Sheet).
